title: Life on Mars
original_lyrics:
[verse]
It's god-awful small affair to the girl with the mousy hair

[bridge]
As she walks through her sunken dream
To the seat with the clearest view
And she's hooked to the silver screen

[bridge]
For she's lived it ten times or more
She could spit in the eyes of fools as they ask her to focus on
Sailors, fighting in the dance hall
Oh man! look at those cavemen go, it's freakest show
Take look at the Lawman, beating up the wrong guy
Oh man! Wonder if he'll ever know he's in the best selling show
Is there life on Mars?
It's on Amerika's tortured brow
Mickey Mouse has grown up cow
Now the workers have struck for fame

[chorus]
See the mice in their million hordes
From Ibeza to the Norfolk Broads
Rule Brittania is out of bounds
To my mother, my dog and clowns

[chorus]
It's about to be writ again
As I ask you to focus on .... Chorus
